name: modeling-studio
description: Turn a sentence or a picture into a clean, high-detail 3D model in your world. Open the 🎨 Studio tab in god mode, or press M (the 🎨 3D studio button) without god mode, describe what you want, add a reference picture, and press Paint or Build 3D: Savi paints the concept onto the studio canvas, then builds a high-poly, fully textured model that turns on the glowing pedestal and gets its own lit shelf slot with a brass name plaque. Every piece remembers how it was made so you can make another the same way. Turn, show or remove pieces from the tab. After installing, run /modeling-studio once to place the studio and add the 🎨 button to your HUD.
